title: Book 8 — Urania, Chapter 59
paragraphs: When they were gathered, and before Eurybiades had proposed the matters for which he had called the commanders together, Themistocles spoke with great vehemence, being very eager to gain his point. As he was speaking, the Corinthian commander, Adeimantos son of Okytos, said: “Themistocles, at the games those who step up for the contest before their time are beaten with rods.” Justifying himself, Themistocles replied: “Yes, but those who remain behind are not crowned.”
